balls.text: gets to the pitch and drives it down to long-on, the sweeper collects easily and has plenty of time to lob the throw back to PK, who collects and breaks the stumps to get Tyagi

full ball now sliding down leg stump, Murali swings and sets off as the ball rolls into the covers, he's just short of his crease as PK collects, turns, and under-arms the ball onto the nonstriker's stumps ... basically Murali didn't ground his bat
short and wide, he gets back and punches past cover and point
bangs it in very short, gets Jakati pulling and the result is a thick top edge over Boucher's head
good old fashioned swat from Murali, looking one way and swinging the other, makes some good contact on that ball and beats mid-off for four
nearly a catch but not close enough to cover, as he uses his feet and chips the ball in the air and it dies before the two fielders running in
short outside off stump, Jakati tries the uppercut and cannot connect
a first-baller for Balaji, making a total mess of his attempt to pull a short-pitched ball dug in outside off stump, gets a top edge that Kumble gobbles up at midwicket
edged and taken! Vinay persists with that attempted yorker outside off stump, lands it right in the blockhole and Oram, backing away, swishes a thin nick through to Boucher
very, very full outside off stump, Oram swings and misses
slower ball served up wide and another swing and miss
short ball now, over the stumps, Jakati pulls and misses
another one goes down, and this too a full toss! Albie just doesn't look the player he's made out to be, slicing a wide full toss to Kumble at extra cover, who takes it easily
picks the slower ball and flat-bats the short ball between midwicket and mid-on, gave himself the elevation and thats a four after ages for Chennai
gives himself some room and drives hard, again to the same spot
pitched up outside off and he drives hard, just wide of extra-cover too
pinches a single last ball, just dabbing wide of the fielder and setting off
the googly again, a tad short and Albie cuts but cant beat cover
slower still, and on a length outside off, Oram drives to mid-off
flat outside leg stump and he clips it off his pads for a single
flights it up, the wrong 'un has some room on it and Albie gets across to get the bat down on ball, cutting late and wide of backward point for a couple

the wheels on Chennai's bus go ... off, off, off ... and thats 22 balls since the last boundary, as Badri comes down and tries to go for half a dozen but fails to find the desired elevation, Uthappa at long-on settles under it and takes with ease
slower ball pitches wide of off stump and slides under Oram's bat
backs away and swings at a short of a length ball, gets it off the bottom part of the bat and Akhil does the fielding himself
finally a decent shot Badri, getting to a fuller and straighter one and driving back past the stumps and Oram
goes back to try and flash it away over point but still no dice
gets across to try one of those en vogue paddles but cant make contact

good shout but not given, because there's no movement, its pitched just around leg stump and hits the pad as Oram thumps forward, he sets off for the single and no leg byes are signaled so must have been a bit of bat in there somewhere
quicker and flatter on the stumps and he turns it toward midwicket
and again, lands it on a good length and Oram drives it back
slows up the pace, tosses it up wider to force Oram come after it, and all he can do is drive it back to the bowler
gives himself room and lofts the fuller ball over cover for one
short and wider and he gets over the bounce, back-cutting to point
flighted up and he plays a reverse sweep for a single
cuts again but cannot beat backward point
quicker one skids on from wide, Badri cuts and misses
tossed up full outside off and Badrinath defends watchfully
shorter, flatter, wider and he dabs a single to short third man

innings comes to an end with a superb catch on the ropes! Kumble floats it up, Hayden swings hard, the ball is up in the for some time during which Vinay Kumar runs across on the deep midwicket boundary trying to size it up, then he runs and takes it, losing balance, he trips ... whoops, one step, two .. but all is well in the end as he makes sure he's just inside the ropes ... amazing reflexes and recovery
big shout but no dice! Kumble flights it up just outside off stump, gets too much height on it and so the umpire shakes his head, Hayden was looking to sweep hard
flights it up in all the right areas and Oram can only defend it back
slows the pace, gets some turn, Oram pushes and misses
again he comes out, this time drilling it back to Roelof's right side, he dives but cannot get there and the ball runs down the ground to long-off for fielding practice
shot, six! Slight use of the feet to collect on the volley and he goes very hard and very straight for maximum
much slower this time, and wider, Oram squirts it down wide of gully

well held, Roelof! Thats one for the reflex album, he dove to his right side, the wrong side, and intercepted a hard drive in the air from Dhoni, who used his feet to a tossed up delivery and chipped it back
super shot when you're on 49! Vinay pitches it up on and around off stump and Hayden unfurls a clever little reverse paddle that takes him to his half-century, well played
short of a length outside off, Hayden drives hard but right to cover
wee bit of room with the shorter ball and Dhoni cuts past point
just early into the shot, chipping in the air wide of mid-on for a single
gets some room to free the arms and does so with a real crude swing to one pitched up outside off stump, not the best of timing and then out on the ropes Roelof sprawls to save runs
down comes Dhoni, looking to punch that to the off side but having to adjust to the length, he swings and gets an inside edge down toward short fine leg
again onto the front foot, gently dabbing to extra cover for one
uses his feet to get to the pitch, then drives past cover and calls for two
tosses it up on the stumps, he swings and inside-edges past midwicket
lovely use of the feet from Hayden, turning a low full toss into a meaty one and he slams that rows back over midwicket for el sixo
plenty of flight and some good dip, makes room and goes mid-off
tosses it up a tad wide and Hayden gets back to chop it away for one
and Dhoni is beaten as he flashes outside off stump
full on the pads, attempted yorker, neatly clipped out to deep midwicket
bouncer this time outside off stump, Hayden flinches, wide not called
back of a length outside off stump, cracked off the back foot for one
change of pace, a bit fuller outside off stump and Hayden slogs along the ground out to the sweeper in the deep
gives him the charge, making room, cracks it past cover and the sweeper covers good ground and slides to save a couple
flights it on middle and leg, just holding it back in the air for a fraction, Hayden is lured forward and gets an inside edge as he swings at the ball as it dips, short fine leg fields
tosses up invitingly outside off stump and Hayden gets the back foot across to cover off before he drives superbly into the covers, Dravid fields on the ropes
slower ball, full on the pads, again Dhoni turns it square for a single
comes out and takes it on the full, turning it wide of midwicket for two
starts walking down, Roelof sees him and changes the pace and line, the ball turns and nearly beats Hayden but he somehow manages a nibble to backward point
flat on off stump, Dhoni gets across and turns it toward mid-on
gets across early and turns the ball from off stump to midwicket and runs
beaten on the flirt, just looking to square drive the full ball but no contact
swings at a fuller one angling in and inside-edges past midwicket
gets forward and drives the fuller ball very hard, on the rise, but mid-off is pretty sharp and a super dive from Praveen saves three for Bangalore
slides down leg stump, beats the bat but there's a leg bye to gully involved
short of a length outside off and he gets back and crunches to mid-off
slower ball, there's the legspinner, pitches outside leg stump and Hayden goes for a booming sweep but loses a hand on the bat, and thus gets no timing
change of pace, tosses it up on a good length and Hayden defends
tosses it up to get Dhoni onto the front foot and driving to mid-off for one
too short outside off stump but Dhoni cannot time it well, he gets back and pulls with too much of an under edge and the ball doesn't go past midwicket
floats it up, Dhoni uses his feet and clips the ball to midwicket
presses forward, then rocks back, and cuts the ball out to the deep
top shot! Dhoni takes on another short ball by getting into position early, then rolling the wrists to pull that superbly in front of square for four
short of a length on the stumps and awkwardly turned to short leg

done in by a South African tag team! Kallis digs it in short outside leg stump, into Raina's body, and he just hops up and turns it off his ribs toward midwicket, where van der Merwe dives forward to take a good catch
much better delivery, pitched up outside off with the angle across and Raina hurriedly gets into position to watchfully defend to point
short, wide and slapped - while airborne - just over point's fingertips
pitches it outside off, Hayden gets behind it and punches toward cover
there's the slog to a slower ball, just spotted it early and clubbed across the line, hit safely over the infield and it finds the ropes for another boundary to Raina
ah the short ball is being used a lot against Raina, who this time gets into a tangle as he pulls across the line, getting a top edge safely over the keeper for four
just short of a length, Raina goes back and pushes the ball to cover
walks outside his stumps, then shuffles as the bowler follows him, so he turns his wrists and paddles the ball out to deep backward square leg for one
too much room outside off stump and so Raina cuts past point for one
back of a length outside leg stump and nudged away for a single
a wicket-maiden over, fantastic! Kallis bangs it in short, Raina goes flashing and very nearly gets an edge on that, he just got up on one leg and flayed the bat at ball
another short ball, this time Raina gets in line and defends to point
and he's welcomed with a short ball, Raina doesn't play those to well and its much the same today, fending at it off his toes and dropping it near his feet

there's a good change-up delivery! Kallis put in the effort and produces a short one that surprises Vijay, a tad late into his attempted pull, and he gives a catch to Uthappa down at fine leg, who gets across and times his collection to perfection
a tad fuller, but by no means a half-volley, starts to come back in from outside off stump and Vijay is hurried into his shot, he adjusts on the flick and plays it back
back of a length just outside off and steered away to backward point
good length, good line, but well played too, Vijay just rolling the wrists and on-driving a single to the left of mid-on to keep hold of the strike for next over
better line and length to Vijay, right on the dime, and he has to defend
there's the slower one, pitched up just around off stump, Hayden picks it and gets the back leg across to cover off before he punches a drive into the covers for one
oooh he's smacked the pants off that one! PK serves up room outside off stump and Hayden swings it across from where it pitched, flat for six over mid-on
thats full and wide, Hayden throws bat at ball and cannot connect
and he too gets the treatment from Hayden, who makes room and struts down, hammering a short and wide ball over extra cover
short of a length outside off stump, getting Hayden up onto his toes, he forces it away nicely and gets third man into play
pitches on a good length, middle and off, and tucked away for one
short of a length outside leg stump, clipped away for a single
super shot that, just saw the marginally fuller ball and gets back to pummel that through the covers, where one man dived in vain, for four more
again he saunters down, this time Vinay errs by serving up a full toss which gets the treatment, swung away wide of midwicket for four more
bouncer over leg stump, Hayden flinches, Doctrove signals wide
and immediately Hayden marches down the track, swatting the short ball just over mid-on's fingertips for four
flat down the pads and Vijay picks it up off his legs into the space wide of midwicket, who runs after it but the batsmen run harder and get a couple
fuller and he gets off the mark with a push past a sluggish mid-off
slower, fuller, and out comes the reverse sweep to backward point
good ball that, pitched up and it skids on with the angle to beat Hayden as he pushes down the wrong line
quicker, flatter delivery on the pads, nudged away for a single
floated up on leg stump, not much turn, Vijay gets across and starts to nudge it away but doesn't get the desired timing

game over in comical fashion! Oram gives Vinay room, he slashes it up and backward of point, Balaji at third man doesn't spot it and is slow to chase, he dives on the boundary but cannot stop the ball from going for four, back in the middle the two batsmen are unsure of whats happening and they are settling for one, then PK says run man, he didn't stop it, so they go for two but in the end everyone sees Balaji signaling four so the match is won with two balls in hand

slower ball, back of a length outside off stump, Vinay gets across and gets the wrists into play superbly, turning it wide of midwicket, PK is calling for the second and they get it easily because Raina returned a poor throw back from the deep
gives him the charge and swats a length ball wide just past midwicket

Taylor what have you done? Takes a step forward and across, Oram holds back the length and Taylor top edges the ball up in the air, Dhoni doesn't for a second lose sight of it as he runs back towards the boundary and takes it easily ... Kiwi to Kiwi, Oram has won that battle when it mattered most
full on the stumps and he drives excellently through extra cover, really good placement and they run back for the second, top shot, and top running
uses his crease well, walking right across the stumps and again clipping the full ball wide of midwicket and mid-on
full outside off stump and he dabs it wide of cover and point for one
walks across his stumps and clips a full ball wide of midwicket, PK drops his bat but hurries on to the other end
low full toss, uses his feet and drives it down to long-on for one
and what a shot, what a shot! PK backs away and clubs a short ball over wide long-on for a super six ... talk about delivering under pressure, excellent shot
full ball, well done, no room and PK pushes to cover and sets off
full on the stumps, he shuffles across and clips wide of midwicket
safest place to score your runs! Its very, very full, in fact almost a yorker just outside off stump and Taylor jams down at it, misses, but ball hits Dhoni's pads and runs away

smart catch from Tyagi! Oram gets Akhil with a short ball, he slogs at top edges and Tyagi, running in from third man, dives superbly and clutches the steepler as it dies in front of him ... its moments like these, and Oram's earlier catch, will really matter in such situations
another full ball and this time he squeezes a single to extra cover
full outside off and he drives past cover and sprints back for two
slower ball on a length outside off and Akhil swats it back to Balaji

now thats not the smartest piece of cricket I've ever seen! Attempted yorker on the stumps, Roelof drives hard straight to cover-point and sets off, the fielder returns an over throw and they get one, then a piece of madness from Roelof ends his manic innings ... he was slow on the return and pranced back over the line with his bat not outstretched as Dhoni received a good lob from Murali and disturbed the stumps, not sure what he was doing there because he was well home but hit bat was dragging by his feet ... after numerous replays the decision is OUT and while Chennai explode Roelof slinks off back to the Bengaluru dug out
balls.dismissal: RE van der Merwe — run out

balls.text: slower ball again, full on the pads and clipped to deep midwicket
shot! Thats where you don't want to be bowling to this man, Taylor gets across and swings the slower length ball flat over midwicket for six, excellent
full again, down the pads, he makes room and just manages to dig it out, gets an inside edge near his pads and he gets called across for the sharp single
bad ball, slower ball slips out way down the pads, Dhoni stops well
full on off stump, searching for the yorker, he gets across and clips it
top bowling, right on middle and off and he drives it straight back
tosses it up wide, he goes for a booming drive and misses out
tosses it up outside leg stump, he gets across and turns it away
flat outside the pads, Roelof works it away off the pads for a single
tosses it up on off stump, he presses forward and defends to cover
and he's struck first ball, tossing the doosra up outside off stump, it takes the outside edge as Boucher loses balance on the drive, Hayden gobbles it up to his left at slip
short of a length, Boucher allows it come to him and dabs it for a single
too much room and he dabs it behind backward point, Tyagi from third man runs after it and then comically dives a month too early and muffs what could have ben stopped
slower ball slants back in and beats the bat, Boucher gets across to cut it fine but makes no contact and the ball dribbles down to Dhoni behind the stumps
very full outside off and Boucher squirts it straight to backward point

great catch by Oram! Kohli pulls a short ball from outside off stump, looks a cracking shot over midwicket until Oram sprints forward from the ropes and dives forward to grasp a tumbling catch an inch or two off the grass, awesome effort and do we have another twist?
right up there in the blockhole and he pushes it down to long-off for one
slower one, flighted on middle and off, Taylor pushes it back past Jakati
back to full and flat and he coolly clips a single wide of midwicket
super shot and this kid has found a groove alright! Skips down, gets the momentum needed, and lofts it high, high, high down the ground for maximum
dances down, drives hard but Jakati takes it rather well
errs in line and Taylor paddles it off his pads for a single
flat on middle and off, Taylor drives and Jakati dives to save runs
not timed to perfection but he's picked his spot and thats six, he charged down and though not to the pitch, carried on with the big shot over midwicket and beat the man running across
quicker and flatter, Kohli drives it back hard and Murali is alert
again tossed up just outside off and it beats a fierce attempt to cut
goes for another cramped cut and fails to make contact

and Hayden makes a mess down at long-on! Kohli gives Murali the charge, lofting it over mid-on down to where Hayden misjudges it completely, he starts coming in but then doesn't pick it up and back peddles but for no use as thats four
aye, close! Murali rips it across Kohli, who shapes to cut and misses
uses his feet and goes over midwicket out to Oram on the bounce
shorter and flatter, he makes room but ends up punching it back
uses his feet, Jakati drops it on a length and does the fielding himself
flatter ball, just hits a length and thats punched to cover
shuffles across and glances the ball off the stumps to short fine leg
slants into the pads and he turns it away in front of square for a single
rips it across and beats Taylor again, who is groping in the dark

lovely flight there outside off stump, sucking Taylor forward and then skidding past the bat, Dhoni collects and in a flash breaks the stumps ... they go upstairs and all is settled when the big screen shows Taylor just had his back foot back inside the line
lands it on a good length, Taylor pushes it across but to the fielder
tossed up again and he punches just wide of the man in close
tosses it up, no turn, Kohli gets back and across and glances very fine
tossed it up on a length and Taylor waits for spin, getting onto the back foot and forcing the ball away square on the off side
too short but he gets away with it as Kohli cuts straight to cover
pitches on off and turns away, he waits and dabs it toward cover-point
lands on middle and off and he uses hard wrists to drive across the line
loops it up nicely on middle and leg, driven on the rise to extra cover
slower ball, tossed up on a length and he steers it wide of cover-point
flat down the pads, allowing Taylor a hard-earned two out to the deep
floats it full outside leg stump, he sweeps and makes no contact
spins across Kohli off a shorter length, he gets back to pull but doesn't time it well and Murali does the fielding
strays down leg stump and Kohli sweeps, and sweeps well, out to the deep where Oram throws his big hulk of a frame around in vain
shorter ball surprises him, he gets back and pushes in the air toward mid-off, who is deep so no hard done
full and flat on middle and leg, clipped nicely this time
tossed up on the stumps, turned just wide of Vijay at midwicket
now he gets across and works a straighter ball out to deep square leg
too short and Kohli transfers the weight, hammering it past cover out to the deep where Balaji doesn't time his dive at all and allows a boundary
fuller ball with some nice dip into Taylor, who clips it to mid-on
slower ball, drifting into the pads, turned wide of Vijay at midwicket
still flat on middle stump and he drives it nicely toward midwicket
starts off flat on middle and leg, no air, and its patted back
errs with a low full toss, slower ball, nicely flicked wide of midwicket
short ball this time but he rides the bounce and guides to third man
wider, a tad shorter, Kohli plays and misses on that occasion
nearly in the block hole, he cocks the wrists and plays it to mid-on
pitches on a length and he pushes the ball to the off side
too straight so Taylor flicks past a diving Hayden at midwicket for two
shorter in length, he tries to dab it fine but Hayden dives at slip to stop
down the pads and he clips it out to deep backward square leg
slower ball, served up outside off and it beats a one-handed chase
straight again, he rolls his wrists to on drive but cant beat midwicket
fuller and straighter and well clipped wide of Oram at mid-on
starts off on a good length, with some shape back in from outside off stump, and the batsman pushes to cover and gets shooed back by the nonstriker
back of a length and he comes forward, defending to backward point
go for a short ball outside off this time and no shot offered
he's got him lbw! Pitches fullish, comes back in and gets him in front of middle and leg as he's late on the shot, seemed unsure of whether to go forward or back
leans into a wide half-volley and goes toward extra cover
back of a length just outside off and he pushes it to the off side
slides down the pads, beats bat and clips the pad to Dhoni
too full down the pads, Taylor heaves and gets a thin leg bye instead
good ball, attempted yorker on the pads, Taylor does well go jam it out and then bisects two men on the leg side, calling Uthappa across for two, well run there
ah, bad ball, just too wide and he slashes it over backward point
gets over the ball and goes hard but cant pierce the off side field
short ball goes away from Taylor, who flashes and misses this time
flashes and flashes well, slapping a generous half-volley past point
back of a length, angling in, pushes to extra cover and scampers
pitches outside off, Taylor comes onto the front foot and drives to cover
fuller this time with some shape back in and Taylor plays it back again
tidy line and length from Albie, not offering Taylor any room to work with and the result is another tap back down the track
short of a length on middle and off and he gets in line to defend
pitches on a length on the stumps and Taylor defends to mid-on
another airy fairy shot over the off side, Tyagi bangs it in and gets good bounce, Uthappa hops up and chases it with an ill-timed steer over cover, still it finds the boundary
fuller, middle and leg, tucked around the corner to open his account

straight to backward point! Not a shot Dravid will be too proud of, just failing to keep a short ball down, he aimed to slap it away but just steered it to Badrinath, who cupped it in front of his face with few hassles
shortish again but he gets up and uses the wrists well to drop it down safely wide of Hayden at slip and third man cannot get across to prevent the boundary
short ball down leg stump, Dravid goes for the shot off the pads but the bounce is too much and he ends up playing it down to the off side
too wide and Dravid goes fishing, unable to put bat on ball
short of a length outside off, Uthappa gets up and steers it behind point
full on leg stump, another mistimed clip and Albie does the fielding
pitches down the pads and hits Dravid clearly down leg stump, still they all appeal but no chance to get those ones in your favour
super shot for four, Dravid just eases into a square drive, punching the wide and full delivery into the gap behind square on the off side
straighter one, Dravid is early on the flick and plays back to Albie

big wicket in the first over! Albie pitches fullish marginally outside off stump, Kallis presses forward gently, not a big stride at all and he gets hit on the front roll, after a long thought umpire Harper raises the finger of fate
straying down the leg side, they can't afford too many of  those, concedes a run
gets a thick outside edge to third man, bowled full on the off and pushes through the line, he's off the mark
